title: Universe-reindexed endpoint scalar extension
statement: For finite and integral ring stages, define scalarAtClosure by reusing the scalar functor, realization, shift, additivity, and exactness fields from an equal-universe algebraically closed coefficient field Ψ at the original coefficient universes Ω. The construction is by the explicit finite/integral stage case split.

proof.text: Case split on the source and target RingStage constructors and reuse the corresponding fields of the supplied Scalar record. The finite and integral coefficient categories do not depend on the closure field.
